title: Cover sphere
note: The dot sphere behind the cover. 2800 points on a Fibonacci shell; `still` seeds them so two captures are the same sphere.

states.label: Seeded
states.note: Fixed seed, rotation held. This is what a capture should show every time.

states.label: Reduced motion
states.note: What a reader with prefers-reduced-motion gets: the sphere is there, it does not spin.
